Searched the catalog · Harlo H15 Dual
Searched the catalog · DC08 Hammer Miner

Hi,

Happy to sort this out. Here are the two you are weighing up, at today's listed prices.

The Harlo H15 Dual is $999. It mines Bitcoin and Dogecoin at the same time, 15 TH/s on SHA-256 plus 1.08 GH/s on Scrypt, around 500W, about 50 dB, built-in power supply: https://heliumdeploy.com/products/harlo-h15-dual

The Hammer DC08 is $539. Scrypt only, so Dogecoin and Litecoin, 480 MH/s at about 137W with a 250W supply: https://heliumdeploy.com/products/hammer-miner-dc08

To give you the exact difference to the cent I need the order number the swap would come off, since what you paid on that line is what gets credited, not the list price. Send me that and which of the two you want, and I will put the figure and the ship date in front of you right away, with the invoice for the difference to follow.

If you want my honest read: if Bitcoin matters to you at all, the H15 Dual is the better buy, because you get both chains in one box. If it is purely Doge and Litecoin, the DC08 does that job for a lot less.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy

Hi,

Thanks for the order number, that gives me the figures.

Your NerdQaxe++ Rev 6.1 came back to our Chattanooga warehouse on June 9 and it has sat with us since. That is far too long to leave you without a working miner, and I am sorry for it.

The credit on it is the full $334.78 you paid, so here is where each option lands.

The Harlo H15 Dual is $999.00, which leaves $664.22 to pay, plus tax where it applies. It is not in stock today, it is a pre-order that ships by Nov 14, 2026.

The Hammer DC08 is $539.00, which leaves $204.22 to pay, plus tax where it applies. That one is in stock at our US warehouse and ships within 2 business days.

For what it is worth, the H15 Dual is the stronger machine because it mines Bitcoin and Dogecoin at once, but the DC08 gets you running next week rather than next month, and it only draws about 137W against the H15's 500W.

The free Hammer BC04 we offered you on October 13 is still on the table too, if you would rather not pay anything at all.

Reply with the one you want and I will set it aside in your name and send you the payment link for the difference. Your unit is already with us, so it ships as soon as that is settled.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
